finding.summary: The 'line' field from issues can be None (per the Issue dataclass in stage2.py: line: int | None). The adapter passes it through directly, which may cause type errors downstream if the eval system expects an integer.
finding.fix: Keep line as-is (None is valid for file-level issues), but document that consumers must handle None. Alternatively, convert None to 0 or -1 with a comment if the eval schema requires an integer.

label: false_positive
label_reason: a null line is valid output (review.schema.json allows it) and case_rules._near treats it as not near any line.
notes: finding.line moved 53 -> 44: at raised_sha fee8a9a the `"line": i["line"]` the finding describes is at eval_adapter.py:44 (53 is the last line of _review); the review cited the wrong line.
